extra_files.content:
# Viability assay protocol v2 (supersedes v1)

- Incubation of 24 h or 48 h are both acceptable; plates of different durations may be pooled.
- Vehicle wells are optional.
- Hit definition: any drop in viability versus vehicle, regardless of p-value.
